title: EventModeling Manifest
description: Describes how a single EventModeling document (see eventmodeling.schema.json) is split across multiple files: which file holds each registry, and the ordered list of slice files (order lives here, and only here -- not reintroduced as a per-slice index field). Joining a manifest with the files it references reproduces exactly the document shape eventmodeling.schema.json validates. This schema validates only the manifest's own skeleton (paths, swimlanes, metadata) -- structural correctness of the full model is re-checked against eventmodeling.schema.json once joined, so id/swimlane shapes are duplicated here deliberately, kept intentionally minimal.

filePath.description: Path relative to the manifest's own directory. No naming convention is required or assumed -- slice files may be organized into any folder layout (flat, by swimlane, by pattern, or otherwise); the manifest's explicit paths are what makes this possible without special-casing any particular scheme.
